finding: A pure function repeated N times is one Bernoulli trial. Two pure predicates do not pool into one rate. Only a check that can flip under the same input earns N greater than 1.

deterministic_gate.boundNote: identical pure-function runs are one trial; naiveMissedRate95 illegally divides by the copy count

mitigation: Tag a check stochastic only when the same input can flip. Do not buy a tighter bound by repeating a script, or by pooling two pure predicates.
